sentences.text:
...Respondents
Petition under Article 226 of the Constitution of India praying that in the circumstances stated in
the affidavit filed therewith, the High Court may be pleased toto issue a writ or order or direction,
more particularly one in the nature of Writ of Mandamus, declaring the action of the 2nd
respondent in passing order vide Proceedings Roc.No.1304/2019/D dated 01.07.2020 in respect of
the lands of the petitioners i.e., an extent of Ac. 2.50 cents, in R.S.No. 498-1C1 and extent of Ac. 2-10
cents in R.S.No. 498-1B of Dirusumarru Village, Bhimavaram Mandal, West Godavari District,, is
without jurisdiction, highly unwarranted, suffers from non-application of mind, highly arbitrary,
malafide, contrary to G.O.Ms.No.259 dated 21.06.2016 ,G.O.Ms.No.367 dated 19-08-2019,
G.O.Ms.No.510 Revenue (Lands-1) Department dated 30.12.2019 and G.O.Ms.No.575 dated
16.11.2018 and contrary to the provisions of The Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in
Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013, highly irrational, violative of
principles of natural justice, violative of Articles 14 and 21 of the Constitution of India, illegal and
unsustainable and pass Ia No: 1 Of 2020 Petition under Section 151 Cpc praying that in the
Polanti Prabhavathi vs State Of Ap on 14 February, 2024

entities.text: Polanti Prabhavathi vs State Of Ap
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text:
1 

circumstances stated in the affidavit filed in support of the petition, the High Court may be pleased
to suspend the operation of the orders of the 2nd respondent vide his Proceedings
Roc.No.1304/2019/D, dated 1.07.2020, relating to the land of the petitioners i.e., an extent of Ac.
2.50 cents, in R.S.No. 498-1C1 and an extent of Ac. 2-10 cents in R.S.No. 498-1B of Dirusumarru
Village, Bhimavaram Mandal, West Godavari District, pending disposal of the above Writ Petition
Ia No: 1 Of 2021 Petition under Section 151 Cpc praying that in the circumstances stated in the
affidavit filed in support of the petition, the High Court may be pleased pleased to vacate the interim
order granted on 22.07.2020 in WP.No. 11920 of 2020 and dismiss the writ petition and pass such
other order Counsel for the Petitioner(s):SRI. C Ramachandra Raju Counsel for the
Respondents: Gp For Revenue

The Court made the following:
In spite of posting the matter under the caption "for dismissal", there is no representation for the petitioners.
2. Earlier occasions also on 24.01.2024 and 31.01.2024, there was no representation for the petitioners when the matter was listed.
3. Hence, this Writ Petition is dismissed for default.
Interim order, if any, deemed to have been vacated.
There shall be no order as to costs.
As a sequel, Miscellaneous Petitions pending, if any, shall stand closed.

JUSTICE B KRISHNA MOHAN 14.02.2024 PNS Polanti Prabhavathi vs State Of Ap on 14 February, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/196924517/
